text:
Maya Chen: Short UX thread on the metrics chart — focusing on legend density indicators, inset sparklines, axis unit clarity, and smoothing presets. Keep replies brief.
Diego Marquez: Spotted a usability issue: when dashboards have dense series (8+), legend becomes a long vertical list and takes too much real estate. Idea: compress with density badges (e.g., small sparkline + count) and a hover panel to expand.
Priya Nair: Love the density badge idea. Suggestion: badge shows a 24h mini-sparkline and a small numeric peak (e.g., "▲ 23k"). Clicking opens a floating panel with full name, color, and visibility toggle.
Sam Wu: Prototype note: mini-sparklines must be SVG and lightweight; render at 40x12 px. For very small charts, fall back to initials+color dot. Also implement an accessible name for the badge: aria-label="Series <name> — peak 23,450 traces".
Maya Chen: Units: axis ticks use compact SI (k, M) with trimmed decimals. Tooltips show full integer + unit and a short percentile for clipped values. Avoid single-letter units like "t".
Diego Marquez: Outlier handling: show density shading behind lines to surface volume. For extreme spikes, clip main view at 99.5th percentile and show a thin inset sparkline below with full scale. Inset should have a toggle "Show full range".
Priya Nair: Smoothing presets: Raw | Trend (7) | Trend (30). Default Raw for alert pages; Trend(7) for overview. When smoothing enabled, add a small dashed raw overlay and a badge "Smoothed" with tooltip explaining algorithm and window size.
Sam Wu: Keyboard/aria: legend badges must be reachable via Tab, Enter toggles expanded panel, Space toggles visibility. Use aria-expanded on the badge. Announce state changes via live region text: "Series <name> hidden". Keep hidden series in DOM at 10% opacity.
Design System Bot: Accessibility reminder: mini-sparkline strokes are considered graphics; if we include text inside the badge it must still meet 4.5:1. Also ensure color pairs for series meet 3:1 for graphics and >=4.5:1 if used as text.
Maya Chen: Copy tweak: change tooltip field from "count" to "traces"; clipped tooltip example: "Value: 123,456 traces (99.7th percentile)". Legend expand panel header: "Series details — <name>".
Diego Marquez: Export behavior: exports ALWAYS use raw underlying values. If view has smoothing or clipping, show a subtle banner: "Note: view has smoothing/clipping applied; exported CSV contains raw data."
Priya Nair: Micro-interaction note: when hovering a legend item, highlight corresponding line with +30% stroke width and fade others to 18% opacity. For keyboard focus, use a 3px focus ring and announce "Focused: <series name>".
Sam Wu: Small config snippet from prototype:
```
unitMode: compact_trim
legendDensity: badge_sparkline
outlierStrategy: clip_995_inset
smoothingPresets: [raw,7,30]
keepHiddenInDOM: true
keyboardLegend: true
```
Maya Chen: Action items: Maya to spec density badge visuals and copy; Diego to prototype clip+inset and inset toggle; Priya to write keyboard/aria flows and live region copy; Sam to implement tiny-sparkline rendering and hover/focus interactions. Design System Bot will run color contrast for badges. Reconvene next Wed for visual QA. :mag:
Sam Wu: I'll add unit tests for focus/keyboard and for inset toggle behavior.
Design System Bot: Preview build posted: https://preview.redwood-inference.com/metrics/density-badges-1772 — please test keyboard, NVDA/VoiceOver, and color-blind palettes.
Maya Chen: Thanks everyone, closing thread.
